name: Command
summary: A creature fails a Wisdom save and obeys a one-word command (Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt) on its next turn.
text: Speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. If it fails a Wisdom saving throw, it carries out the command on its next turn. Choose one: Approach (it moves toward you by the shortest, most direct route and ends its turn once it is within 5 feet of you); Drop (it drops whatever it is holding, then ends its turn); Flee (it spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest means it has); Grovel (it gains the Prone condition, then ends its turn); Halt (on that turn it doesn't move and takes no action or Bonus Action). Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: you can affect one more creature for each slot level above 1.
